description:
Election Commission - Appoint the officer for the Administrative District as the Returning Officer for election members to the electing members to the Local 
Authority Election
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically concerns the appointment of a Returning Officer for the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) for the purpose of conducting elections. The content falls under electoral processes and appointments related to election administration, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) covering electoral commission appointments and decisions.
